links.comparator_used: Standard prompt with no reading-level or audience instruction
links.outcome: Readability of chatbot answers (8 readability indices) for ChatGPT-4 and Gemini-2.0
links.effect: Almost all readability indices showed standard responses required a higher education level and simplified (sixth-grade prompt) responses a lower level; no numeric values given in the abstract. Accuracy p-values (0.557 standard, 0.090 simplified) compared the two chatbots, not the prompt types.
links.quote: In particular, almost all readability indices suggest that standard AI chatbot responses require a higher level of education for comprehension, whereas simplified responses require a lower level of education.
